THE LIFECYCLE WAS RECONCILED, NOT REPLAYED. The work of this phase happened while its record sat at 'draft' with an empty history: every governed run, every reviewer call and every proof occurred without the state machine moving. On 2026-08-26 the record was walked draft -> prompted -> implementing -> validating -> evidence -> awaiting_review -> awaiting_closure through `projectos phase advance`, one command per transition, no JSON edited by hand. `draft -> closed` was attempted first and the runtime refused it as an illegal transition, which is why the full path was walked.

THE TIMESTAMPS IN THAT HISTORY ARE TODAY'S, DELIBERATELY. All six entries read 2026-08-26T15:39 and each carries the note that the work occurred while the record remained draft and is being recorded now. Backdating would have produced a tidier history that was false. The accurate statement is that the reconciliation happened today against evidence that already existed.
